sequences.name: Reader
abilities: Enhanced Mental Attributes: Enhanced memory, comprehension, and learning abilities.
Knowledge Addiction: Unusual desire for Knowledge.
Reading: Gain a wealth of Knowledge through extensive Reading.
Ritualistic Magic: Gain the ability to use Ritualistic Magic.

sequences.name: Student of Ratiocination
abilities: Enhanced Mental Attributes: Increase in observational and logical reasoning skills.
Ritualistic Magic: Experts in Ritualistic Magic.

sequences.name: Detective (Knowledge Keeper)
sequences.description: A Detective is a 'profession' that focuses on knowledge acquisition and reasoning ability, along with good fighting and weapon handling skills.
abilities: Enhanced Mental Attributes: Can become Masters of reasoning.
Weapon Proficiency: Proficient in using weapons.
Physical Enhancement: Have become more agile.
Reconstruction: Can use Beyonder methods to analyze and Reconstruct events that have occurred within a certain area.
Ritualistic Magic Master: Can become a Master when it comes to Ritualistic Magic.

sequences.name: Polymath
sequences.description: This Sequence allows them to learn and understand a great deal. Because of their extensive knowledge, they become Jack-of-all-trades, able to identify, see clearly, remember, and Imitate abilities they've encountered.
abilities: Analysis: Can Analyze Beyonder powers used by an opponent, identify the specific situation, and understand strengths and weaknesses.
Imitation: Once sufficiently Analyzed, there is a chance to Imitate an Analyzed ability to a certain extent.

sequences.name: Mysticism Magister
abilities: Mystic Arts: Masters various magical, diverse, unique, and rare Mystic Arts, and can even invent their own strange yet effective Spells.
Imitation: Imitated Spells can now have 60% of the original effect.
Invisibility: Can make themselves or others turn transparent and faint.

sequences.name: Prophet
sequences.description: They begin to master higher levels of Mystical knowledge in the realm of Fate, thereby gaining the ability of 'Prophecy'.
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Gain the physical power of a Demigod.
Prophecy: Can get a relatively clear view of the most likely scenarios to happen in the future.
Astral World Mystic Arts: Can acquire some non-dangerous Astral World Knowledge and create Mystic Arts that utilize Astral World power.
Imitation: Imitation of Spells is at 80% potency of the original effects.
Analyze: Can discern Beyonders from ordinary people and decipher secrets hidden within a Seal.
Mystic Arts: Enhanced ability to create various Mystic Arts.

sequences.name: Cognizer
abilities: Principles: Gain partial authority over Principles.
Cognizing: Ability to understand the rules of the world and grasp many profound mysteries; can see through and Analyze symbols and use them to create Spells.

sequences.name: Wisdom Angel
abilities: Wisdom: Always make the most correct choices at the right time due to ability to accurately foresee shifts in situations.
Imitation: Imitated abilities and Spell effects can reach 90% of the original's potency.
Can see the target's strengths and weaknesses, as well as unravel the mysteries, weaknesses, or flaws of the observed object.

sequences.name: Omniscient Eye
abilities: Omniscience: Can see the information about anyone and anything, regardless of whether it pertains to knowledge about a target's past, present, or future.
Astral World Mentor: Can manipulate Astral World concepts to render certain actions ineffective, cause errors, or amplify their impact.
Imitation: Imitated abilities and Spell potency are now 100% identical to the original, but does not involve authority.

sequences.name: White Tower
abilities: Omniscience: Has Omniscience over all things, unaffected by the Spirit World; can Imitate any ability, achieving the original's power, or even optimize and surpass it.
Principles: Can 'open source' Spells to be used by ordinary people.
Astral World Ladder: Can influence the concept of Astral World convergence.
Creation: Partial authority over Creation.
Calamity: Partial authority over Calamity.
Wisdom: Partial authority over Wisdom.
Learning: Partial authority over Learning.
Analysis: Partial authority over Analysis.
